newsitem.title: POLAND: SOCCER-SOKOL TYCHY QUIT POLISH FIRST DIVISION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SOKOL TYCHY QUIT POLISH FIRST DIVISION.

text.p: Sokol Tychy quit the Polish first division, the soccer club's management announced on Wednesday.
The club, 17th in the league, did not specify the reason for their decision, but they have endured poor results recently, including a 6-0 trouncing by 14th-placed Gornik Zabrze last Saturday.
The remaining matches involving Sokol this season will be counted a 3-0 forfeit.
